column1: Whole-IL Morgan radius 2 / 2048 bits / chirality. Fingerprint distance is representation-specific and can hide ion-specific differences.
Diversity50 is mean leave-one-out nearest-neighbour distance within 200 uniform 50-IL samples per training set. This is descriptive rarefaction, not model training or biological replication.
Main plot ratios are means of five paired seed ratios, with sample SD. These differ from ratios of mean scores.
Subgroup ratios average individual model errors across seeds and rows within IL, then compare mean IL errors. This does not evaluate an ensemble predictor.
Subgroup intervals use 5000 paired whole-IL draws. Groups below five ILs retain scores/counts but no CI
Cross-property correlations have n=11. Leave-one-property-out ranges are sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. No P values or automatic threshold.
Partial rank correlations linearly remove ranked training-IL count
column2: eleven heterogeneous tasks cannot establish an independent causal diversity effect.
